name: Ronaldinho
years: Ballon d'Or 2005; last pro match 2015; retired 2018; Ravenna comeback 2026

recent_news.headline: Ronaldinho named Hotcoin brand ambassador in Brazil
facts: Hotcoin is a crypto and multi-asset trading platform founded in 2017 with 8.1M+ users claimed in its own press release.
Campaign tagline: 'Play Your Way. Make It Magic.' Brand initiatives, user experiences and events promised 'in the coming months'.
Sponsored press release (GlobeNewswire), not independent reporting; carries a not-investment-advice disclaimer.
recent_news.note: Sponsored content. Do not endorse or joke about crypto products; treat as a neutral 'new job' beat only.

recent_news.headline: Ravenna coach Mandorlini: door 'wide open' for Ronaldinho to play again
facts: Coach Andrea Mandorlini said Ronaldinho told him he would like to return and enjoyed time with the squad.
He praised Ronaldinho's influence and said he played a key role in the derby win.
Ravenna are second in Serie C; Ronaldinho signed in June and holds a stake in the club.

recent_news.headline: Antonio Cassano calls Ronaldinho's comeback a 'pagliacciata'
facts: Cassano said Ronaldinho is one of the five greatest players ever but called the return an ugly spectacle.
He asked what Ronaldinho was doing on the pitch at 46 'in those conditions' and guessed friendship with Cipriani or a big fee.
A CNN Brasil headline on 16 Nov says he caused 'discomfort' in Serie C, according to a journalist.
recent_news.note: Cassano's 'conditions' comment touches on physical fitness; attribute the quote, never add body jokes.

recent_news.headline: Ronaldinho's comeback-match shirt goes to auction on MatchWornShirt
facts: The signed shirt worn in the Forli match was opened for auction on 15 Nov, jointly with Ravenna.
Bidding was just above R$17,000 with 42 bidders at the time of reporting; auction runs to the 25th.
A signed mini-ball is part of the lot.

recent_news.headline: Ronaldinho after Ravenna debut: 'if the president calls me, I'll come back'
facts: He said the game 'went by too quickly' and the dressing room and fun on the pitch were the best part.
President Ignazio Cipriani said Ronaldinho did not want to leave the pitch; asked about a return: 'We'll see how things go'.
Vice-president Ariedo Braida hopes to see him at the club again; nothing confirmed.

recent_news.headline: Business report: Ronaldinho Day numbers and the criticism
facts: About 7,000 in a stadium expanded for the day; tickets sold out within minutes, partial ticket revenue near EUR 200,000; hospitality seats EUR 150.
Italian press (Messaggero, Corriere dello Sport) reportedly put his fixed fee near EUR 500,000, tied to appearance and promo work; Ravenna Instagram gained 200,000+ followers and passed 340,000.

Sportitalia director Michele Criscitiello called it damaging to the league's image; season-ticket holders had to buy a separate ticket; NSS says Ronaldinho left the stadium at half-time and played almost entirely from a standing position (LiveScore says he left during the second half).
recent_news.note: Fee figure is press-reported, not confirmed by club. Roast material: standing play, early exit, ticket pricing.

recent_news.headline: Ronaldinho, 46, makes Ravenna debut: 2-0 win over Forli, 45 minutes, no goal
facts: First competitive match in 11 years (last: Fluminense, Sept 2015); started at No. 10 in Serie C Group B, matchday 14.
28 touches, one key pass, two right-sided corners; involved in the build-up to Giulio Donati's opening goal (35th/36th minute per sources).
He stayed on 299 career goals and missed his target of a 300th; he was replaced at the break.
recent_news.note: Sources differ on minute of the goal (35' vs 36') and on touches (about 20 vs 28).

recent_news.headline: Debut atmosphere: R10 Stand, Times Square, Sky Italia and a triple bow
facts: A temporary 1,800-seat 'R10' stand was added (Korea Times/AFP).
Match shown live on Sky Italia (Flashscore) and on Times Square screens (Il Resto del Carlino); Dida and Serginho stayed on the pitch with him at half-time (LiveScore).
He received applause at half-time and bowed three times to the home end.
recent_news.note: Attendance conflicts: about 7,000 (NSS, Carlino) vs 12,000-seat stadium sold out (LiveScore) vs 5,000 + 1,800 temporary (AFP). Bocelli and flares could not be verified and were removed.

recent_news.headline: Mandorlini: Ronaldinho starts in a 4-3-3; viral 'glue on the boot or AI?' training clip
facts: Coach: 'We'll play a 4-3-3, and Ronaldinho will start. Working with him is fantastic.' He also said the squad had not trained much with him.
A final-training ball-control clip went viral, with headlines asking whether it was glue on the boot or AI; the article neither confirms nor debunks.

Ronaldinho cited friendship with president Cipriani and 'a unique, special moment' as reasons for the comeback (separate Yahoo article); Ravenna sat second with 29 points from 13 matches, Forli 14th with 15.
recent_news.note: Use the 'AI' angle only as a joke about the clip going viral; no claim that it is fake.

recent_news.headline: CNN Brasil: mystery around Ronaldinho's training and physical preparation
facts: No details had been released about his training routine, his arrival date in Italy or how long he would train with teammates.
Il Resto del Carlino questioned his preparation and the time available to integrate him.
Ravenna were second in Group B with 26 points after 12 rounds, behind Spezia.
recent_news.note: About fitness and preparation. Use only as news, never as a body joke.

recent_news.headline: Ravenna announce the date: Ronaldinho returns on 15 November vs Forli
facts: Club post (translated): 'The magic never left. Now it is time to take it back to the pitch.'
Owner Ignazio Cipriani said the aim was to bring the whole city closer to the team.
Ravenna were second in Group B with 20 points from 10 matches, eight behind leaders Spezia.

recent_news.headline: R10 kit sells 2,000 in 48 hours; he was not on the bench for Ravenna's league opener
facts: Presented in Ravenna on 20 August with 3,000+ present; shirts cost EUR 129; about 2,000 sold online in the first 48 hours (Carlino reported this on 1 Aug).
He was not even on the bench for the league opener vs Reggiana on 24 August.
He was registered on the squad list; owner Cipriani, 38, said the signing was central to the project, not just marketing.

recent_news.headline: Ronaldinho lands at Forli airport; beachside presentation (just outside the 90-day window, explains the current story)
facts: Landed by private jet and signed balls for airport staff; thousands attended a beachside ceremony in rain.
Said 'I'm here to help' and 'it depends on the president and coach' when asked about playing.
At the signing he posed with the new shirt draped over his 2005 Ballon d'Or trophy (Flashscore); he missed the league opener at Reggio Emilia.
recent_news.note: Dated about 92 days before 2026-11-20; kept because it explains the November comeback.

now.headline: Back from retirement at 46 as a registered player, minority shareholder and ambassador of Serie C club Ravenna FC by Cipriani.
now.club_or_role: Ravenna FC (Italy, Serie C Group B, third tier): registered player (shirt No. 10), shareholder, club ambassador and strategic partner; his R10 brand is linked to the club's kit (Flashscore and Goal call R10 the official technical sponsor/shirt supplier; the club's own June post mentions a four-year Nike technical partnership from the 2024 takeover, so the current kit-supplier set-up is unclear).
now.signed: Announced 23 June 2026 at Cipriani Miami (official club post, which says he signs as a registered player); Goal and Football Italia describe the agreement as struck in August; arrived in Italy around 20 August 2026 (thescore: Thursday; Flashscore says 21 Aug; Sporza says Wednesday); first league squad listing for the 24 August opener at Reggio Emilia but not on the bench.
now.contract: Terms not published. Press (Messaggero, Corriere dello Sport via NSS Sports) reported a fixed component near EUR 500,000 tied to appearance and promo work, plus image rights and merchandise. Treat as reported, not confirmed.
now.this_season_numbers: 1 competitive appearance (15 Nov, 2-0 vs Forli): started, about 45 minutes, 0 goals, involved in the build-up to the opening goal, 28 touches, 1 key pass, 2 corners (LiveScore). Career tally stays at 299 goals (266 club + 33 Brazil senior), one short of the 300 he wants.
now.team_situation: Ravenna were second in Serie C Group B, 29 points from 13 matches before the derby (Yahoo); leaders Spezia (Korea Times/AFP after the derby: six points behind). Owner Ignazio Cipriani (took over 2024 with investor Black Duck) wants Serie A; best Serie B finish was 8th in 1996-97. Next fixture: Livorno v Ravenna, 22 Nov 2026, 15:30 (Goal).
what_people_say: Coach Mandorlini: door 'wide open' for him to play again; he praised his influence and said he played a key role in the derby win.
Ronaldinho: 'if the president calls me, I'll come back'; football 'went too fast'.
Antonio Cassano: 'a pagliacciata' (a clown show). Sportitalia's Michele Criscitiello: damaging to the league's image.

Ravenna owner Ignazio Cipriani, quoted by Correio da Manha on 3 Sept (before the debut), insisted the signing is not a simple front or marketing move. After the derby he said Ronaldinho did not want to come off (ESPN).
side_projects: Hotcoin brand ambassador in Brazil (announced 19 Nov, sponsored release).
Signed match shirt up for auction on MatchWornShirt (bids above R$17,000).
Flashscore interview reports an Amazon Prime docu-series 'Vida de Campeones' and the 'Wine of the Champions' winery project in Puglia (interview undated, June/Aug 2026).
next_known_events: 22 Nov 2026: Livorno v Ravenna; no confirmation he will play.

quick_context: Ronaldinho won the 2005 Ballon d'Or and was FIFA World Player of the Year in 2004 and 2005, the third player to win that award more than once.
At Barcelona he won La Liga in 2004-05 and 2005-06 and the 2005-06 Champions League; in 2005-06 he scored 26 goals (17 in La Liga, 7 in the Champions League).
He won the 2002 World Cup with Brazil, finished with 33 goals in 97 caps for Brazil, and his retirement was confirmed in January 2018.

roast_past.angle: Fluminense 2015: 80 days, 9 official games, zero goals, zero assists, contract ended by mutual consent. The last time he played, it lasted less than a school term.
roast_past.note: 80 days, 9 official matches, no goals/assists: CNN Brasil. Contract terminated by mutual agreement on 28 Sept 2015: Wikipedia.

roast_past.angle: The 2002 World Cup England match: scores a 40-yard free kick over Seaman, and seven minutes later he is sent off. Brilliant and gone in under ten minutes.

2007-08: Barcelona sold him after a season without major trophies, with reports of partying and poor training; Ancelotti publicly questioned his physical condition at Milan. Keep it to 'party reputation', no health angle.
His retirement in 2018 was announced by his brother and agent, not by a farewell match. Eight years later he announced the comeback himself.

Milan paid EUR 22.05 million for him in 2008 (after he turned down a GBP 25.5 million City offer), and he later moved on to Flamengo, Atletico Mineiro, Queretaro and Fluminense: a world tour of ex-giants.
Trophy drought at the top: after 2005-06 he never won the Champions League again; his last big club prize was the 2013 Copa Libertadores (4 goals, 8 assists).
He stopped playing on 299 goals, one short of 300, and the 300th became the stated reason for this comeback (ESPN: he chose Ravenna to chase the 'magic number').

roast_now.angle: 11 years without an official match, then 45 minutes in Serie C: first touch after about 7 min 35 sec, roughly 20 to 28 touches in total.

He played the first half and left the stadium early (NSS: at half-time rather than staying with the team; LiveScore: during the second half; sources differ). NSS wrote he played almost entirely from a standing position, calling for the ball at his feet (use as 'conserved energy', attribute to NSS, no body jokes).
Preparation: Coach Mandorlini on 14 Nov: 'We haven't trained him much, but the important thing is that he's here with us.' Coach also said he would start in a 4-3-3.

The marketing machine: billboards in Milan (about 300 km away) on 31 July, shirts at EUR 129 with about 2,000 sold in 48 hours, a temporary 1,800-seat 'R10 Stand', hospitality tickets at EUR 150, and season tickets not valid for the match.
Critics in full voice: Cassano calls it a 'pagliacciata' (clown show); Sportitalia's Criscitiello says it damages the league. Ronaldinho answers with the same smile.
The shirt he wore for 45 minutes is already on auction, signed, with 42 bidders above R$17,000. The most efficient 45 minutes of his career.
Not on the bench for the season opener on 24 August, then a hero's welcome on 15 November: a rare case of a player whose benching was a marketing plan.
After showing a first-touch control in training he joked that people would say it was AI (Sporza). Viral clip headlines asked if it was glue or AI. Use as a self-aware gag, not as a claim of fakery.
roast_now.note: Sporza quote (page date inconsistent: URL 2026/08/20, byline 15 Nov) and Yahoo headline only; the 'at the airport' framing was wrong.

praise.angle: 2005 Ballon d'Or plus back-to-back FIFA World Player of the Year (2004, 2005); only the third player to win that award more than once.
praise.number: 2 FIFA World Player awards, 1 Ballon d'Or

praise.angle: 19 Nov 2005 at the Bernabeu: 2 goals in a 3-0 win, and Real Madrid fans applauded him, an ovation Wikipedia says only Maradona had previously received there as a Barcelona player.
2005-06: 26 goals (17 La Liga, 7 Champions League) and a La Liga plus Champions League double.
2002 World Cup winner; the 40-yard free kick over Seaman against England.
2013 Copa Libertadores with Atletico Mineiro: 4 goals and 8 assists, plus South American Footballer of the Year.

46 and still sells out: about 2,000 shirts in 48 hours (Carlino, Correio da Manha), 3,000+ at his August presentation, 200,000+ new Ravenna Instagram followers around the derby (NSS), and Times Square screens.

no_joke_topics: Health, injuries, weight and physical-condition speculation (CNN Brasil's 'fitness mystery' and Cassano's 'in those conditions' are quotes to attribute, not jokes)
Family, including his brother and agent Roberto and any bereavements

Legal troubles: the 2020 Paraguay fake-passport case (Wikipedia: held in custody, released 24 Aug 2020 on a plea deal with fines) and any fraud or pyramid-scheme complaints (an earlier note about a 21/10/2026 Futebol Justica ruling could not be verified and was dropped)
Crypto or investment products (Hotcoin): neutral mention only; no endorsement, no scam jokes
Anyone's age beyond neutral facts about the 11-year gap (do not mock appearance)

flipbook_ideas: Ronaldinho in a Ravenna No. 10 shirt does a rainbow flick over a tiny cartoon calendar showing '11 YEARS', then looks at his watch at 45 minutes.
A 'half-time bow' gag: he bows three times to the stands, then the scoreboard shows 299 and a '300?' sign falls off.
Billboard gag: a giant cartoon Ronaldinho on a Milan billboard waves at a tiny Ravenna stadium 300 km away.
The signed-shirt auction: a paddle-raising crowd, the shirt on a pedestal, price tag climbing past R$17,000 while Ronaldinho does the shaka.
Footvolley training montage: a cartoon Ronaldinho on a beach net, a coach holding a clipboard marked 'tactics: also footvolley'.
Critics gag: a cartoon clown nose floats toward him; he catches it with a flick and uses it as a ball.

image_reference_notes.signature_look: Warm, wide, toothy smile (Reuters called him 'toothy-grinned', Richard Williams 'cartoonish smile', both in Wikipedia); playful, relaxed body language. Hair and headband details are not documented in the sources read: GAP, check recent photos.
image_reference_notes.current_look: GAP: hair and beard in 2026 not described in the sources read. Check Ravenna's official posts and Instagram before drawing.
image_reference_notes.kit_colours: Ravenna: white home shirt with R10 branding, number 10, club name 'Ravenna FC by Cipriani' (Il Resto del Carlino, CNN Brasil; main shirt sponsor not verified). Earlier eras: Barcelona blue and garnet, Milan red and black, Brazil yellow and green.
image_reference_notes.expressions: Big grin, wave to the crowd, mild protest smile toward the referee (Il Resto del Carlino), triple bow to the home end.
image_reference_notes.signature_pose: The shaka (surf-style hand sign): Ravenna fans showed white boxing-glove designs tied to his shaka (Il Resto del Carlino); the AFP report did not mention it, so confirm with footage.

claims.claim: Ronaldinho made his Ravenna debut on 15 Nov 2026 in a 2-0 Serie C win over Forli, playing the first half.
The debut was his first competitive match since Fluminense in 2015.
He did not score and remained on 299 career goals; he wanted a 300th.
Giulio Donati scored the opener after a move Ronaldinho started (35th minute per LiveScore and Flashscore, 36th per Korea Times/AFP).
Ronaldinho had 28 touches, one key pass and took two corners.
Il Resto del Carlino counts about 20 touches, with a first touch after 7 min 35 sec.
Ronaldinho said 'if the president calls me, I'll come back' and that the game went too quickly.
Mandorlini said the door is 'wide open' for Ronaldinho to play again (19 Nov 2026).
Ravenna are second in Serie C and Ronaldinho signed in June and holds a stake in the club.
Ronaldinho was announced by Ravenna on 23 June 2026 at Cipriani Miami as a registered player; Ravenna has a four-year Nike technical partnership.

Ronaldinho is a shareholder in Ravenna (ESPN) and his R10 brand is tied to the shirts (Flashscore, Goal); coach is Andrea Mandorlini and owner is Ignazio Cipriani (Football Italia, Ravenna club post).
Ravenna announced on 23 Oct 2026 that the debut would be 15 Nov (Sunday 17:30 CET, per Goal); next match Livorno v Ravenna on 22 Nov at 15:30.
As of 24 Oct, Ravenna were second in Group B with 20 points from 10 matches, eight behind Spezia.
Before the derby Ravenna had 29 points from 13 matches, Forli 15 points (14th place).
CNN Brasil reported on 2 Nov that no details of his training routine were public and Ravenna had 26 points after 12 rounds.
Ravenna kit price is EUR 129; about 2,000 shirts sold in 48 hours; 3,000+ attended the 20 Aug presentation; he was not on the bench on 24 Aug vs Reggiana.
Billboards of Ronaldinho in the R10 Ravenna shirt appeared in Milan on 31 July with a QR link to the online store.
He landed at Forli airport on a private jet and said 'I'm here to help' and 'it depends on the president and coach'.
The match shirt is on auction at MatchWornShirt, bids just above R$17,000 from 42 bidders as of 16 Nov; auction runs to the 25th.
Reported fixed fee near EUR 500,000 (Messaggero and Corriere dello Sport via NSS).
About 7,000 attended; ticket revenue near EUR 200,000 (partial); Ravenna Instagram gained 200,000+ followers.
Attendance is reported inconsistently: 12,000 seats sold out (LiveScore) vs a 5,000-capacity ground with a 1,800-seat temporary stand (AFP).
Criscitiello of Sportitalia called the event damaging to the league's image; NSS says Ronaldinho left the stadium at half-time (LiveScore says during the second half).
Cassano called the comeback 'una pagliacciata' on 18 Nov 2026 and asked what he was doing there at 46 'in those conditions'.
Hotcoin named Ronaldinho brand ambassador in Brazil on 19 Nov 2026 (sponsored release).

Mandorlini said on 14 Nov: 'We haven't trained him much, but the important thing is that he's here with us' (Football Italia, which says only that Ronaldinho was 'expected to feature'); the 'will start' quote is from Yahoo.
Mandorlini announced a 4-3-3 with Ronaldinho starting; a final-training clip went viral; Ravenna had 29 points from 13 matches.
Ronaldinho cited friendship with Cipriani and a 'unique, special moment' as reasons for the comeback.
Ronaldinho is a shareholder of the club; Ravenna president Cipriani said Ronaldinho did not want to come off (ESPN; 'told Sky Italia' not found).
Flashscore interview: he said he would play a few minutes in an official match and then assess; docu-series 'Vida de Campeones' and winery project mentioned (undated interview).

A temporary 1,800-seat 'R10 Stand' was added to a 5,000-capacity ground (Korea Times/AFP); the match was shown on Times Square screens (Il Resto del Carlino, NSS) and live on Sky Italia (Flashscore). Bocelli and flares could not be verified.
Dida and Serginho were present at the match.
Ronaldinho won the 2005 Ballon d'Or and the 2005 FIFA World Player of the Year; he was the third player to win the FIFA award more than once.
19 Nov 2005 at the Bernabeu: two goals in a 3-0 win; Real Madrid fans applauded him.
2005-06: 26 goals (17 La Liga, 7 Champions League) and a La Liga/Champions League double.
2002 World Cup quarter-final: 40-yard free kick past Seaman; sent off seven minutes later for a foul on Danny Mills.
2013 Copa Libertadores: 4 goals and 8 assists; South American Footballer of the Year 2013.
Barcelona sold him to Milan in 2008 after a 2007-08 season with no major trophies and reports of partying and poor training; fee EUR 22.05 million.
He retired officially in January 2018, announced by his brother and agent.
Brazil record: 33 goals in 97 appearances (senior).
Fluminense 2015: 80 days, nine official matches, no goals or assists (CNN Brasil); contract terminated by mutual agreement 28 Sept 2015 (Wikipedia).
Career goal totals: Wikipedia gives 266 club goals and 328 total with all national-team levels; 299 in press = 266 club + 33 Brazil senior (ESPN: retired on 299).
Ronaldinho posed with the new shirt draped over his 2005 Ballon d'Or trophy at signing.
Flashscore says Ravenna's highest point was eighth place in Serie B in 1996-97; Cipriani wants Serie A (CNN Brasil: first time in the club's history).
Ronaldinho's final-training clip: headlines asked whether it was glue on his boot or AI; the article does not say either way.
